courses.title: Social Sector Engagement and Community Outreach Practicum
courses.choice_note: [11] A Community Engagement Experience is required for all JSOM majors in fall 2018 catalog or later. Students may fulfill the requirement with BA 4095 upon completion of 100 service hours for 0 semester credit hour degree requirement only, or with BPS 4396 or ENTP 4340 or IMS 4335 or MKT 4360 for 3 semester credit hours. The 0 SCH course BA 4095 is recommended as the most efficient way to satisfy the requirement. Students will be registered for BA 4095 for 0 SCH in the semester they complete 100 service hours.

courses.title: Business Analytics Internship
courses.choice_note: [12] An Internship (Practicum) of at least 160 working hours is required for all JSOM majors. The zero semester-credit-hour internship courses, BUAN 4090 or BA 4090, are recommended as the most efficient way to satisfy this requirement. Students who are employed in full-time jobs may fulfill their internship requirement with their current employer as a special project for registration in BA 4090 with preapproval from their program director.
